description:
Generate Voronoi (Thiessen) polygons from the populated places layer.

1. Launch gvSIG Desktop and create a new View.
2. Add the shapefile '/home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp' to the View.
3. Open the Geoprocessing Toolbox (System toolbox) and find the 'Voronoi' or 'Thiessen' polygons algorithm (usually under Sextante/SAGA or Computational Geometry).
4. Run the tool using the populated places layer as input.
5. Save the output result as a shapefile to '/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/voronoi_cities.shp'.
6. Ensure the resulting polygon layer is added to the View.
